title: Uruguayan Roast Lamb
description: A delicious and flavorful Uruguayan-style roast lamb dish, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe combines the rich flavors of lamb with a smoky Uruguayan twist.
instructions: Rinse the lamb leg and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb leg, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb leg in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Use a meat thermometer to check the internal temperature of the lamb. It should reach 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the Uruguayan roast lamb with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or mashed potatoes.
